body:
# Chrono Compass

**Never lose your gear, miss a rare event, or spend hours hunting for a Wandering Trader again.** 

Chrono Compass is a lightweight, highly responsive utility mod that introduces a brand-new tracking tool. Instead of just pointing to the world spawn, the Chrono Compass allows you to dynamically track temporary world events in real-time with a sleek, on-screen HUD.

## Features

Equip the compass and right-click to open the target selection GUI. You can actively track:

*   **Last Death Locator:** Instantly track the exact coordinates of your previous death. The custom HUD even includes a real-time **Despawn Timer** so you know exactly how long you have to recover your items before they vanish.
*   **Wandering Trader Finder:** Stop wandering aimlessly. The compass locks onto the nearest Wandering Trader, updating your distance and their coordinates in real-time as they move around the world.
*   **Lightning Strike Tracker:** Chasing charged creepers or looking for rare spawns? The compass can pinpoint the exact location of the most recent lightning strike.

## Custom HUD & Real-Time Tracking

No need to constantly open chat or check debug screens. When holding the Chrono Compass, a clean, non-intrusive HUD appears on your screen displaying:
*   Active Target Type
*   Exact XYZ Coordinates
*   Live Distance Calculation (in blocks)
*   Dynamic Timers (for temporary entities or item drops)
